description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Approval' class within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Account' namespace. The class provides methods to manage customer approval data, including adding approvals and deleting approvals from the database.

classes.name: Approval
classes.description: A PHP class responsible for handling customer approval operations, such as adding and deleting approval records in the database within the Opencart system.

methods.name: addApproval
methods.description: Adds a new approval record for a customer with specified customer ID and type.

methods.name: deleteApprovals
methods.description: Deletes all approval records associated with a specific customer ID.
